comments: In view of the incipit and colophon reported in [4TBERVZD]: 14, this is a topical outline on the three chapters of the Pramāṇaviniścaya (ID:3774), presumably by the same person who authored a commentary with the same title, work (ID:5271), i.e., Rin chen tshul khrims (ID:5954).
